formula.arithmetic: IEEE754 binary32; current native LookupApplyStatsForLevel and ScaleStats verified bit-exact on 24 representative cases; current normal/freeplay table comparison covers all 94 class/level rows.
formula.supportedSaveScope: formicarium level-data saves; exact owning player must be zero; do not infer mode from arbitrary user filenames
formula.retainedHealthBuffs: This formula requires zero retained ColonyBuffs of BuffType=0 for the same CreatureName. Otherwise preserve their native ordered float32 additions before scaling or reject.
formula.newGamePlus: GetCreatureStats global map after row lookup alters FoodValue only; no NG+ HP multiplier for owned player units in this function.
formula.medicalSpawnScaling: AColonyCreature applies SpawnStatScailing to FullHealth with mulss; 1 skips and 0.6 uses the same multiplication. Mod native.refresh_creature repeats this native scale after LookupApplyStatsForLevel.
formula.subTenantFlags: The three reviewed stats functions do not read bIsSubTennent. Ordinary medical subtenants use saved SpawnStatScailing. The separate foreign-subtenant restore chain is outside this proof and affected foreign targets must be rejected.
formula.healthEligibility: Positive ledger Health for matching group, OR non-snapshot SlaveMaker at tier 2 (mod balance 90 -> native 80 before scaling).
formula.capturedSnapshots: ActorTags containing EAA_SlaverCopy_v1: are preserved without colony Health stripping; snapshot HP/tags/owner remain byte-exact for native reload.

runtimeValidation.scope: Current-build representative native actors at levels 1-3 and scales 1 and 0.6; not a claim of native execution for all classes.

acceptanceBoundaries: Current native oracle covers exactly 4 classes / 24 cases; all 94 native table rows match current normal/freeplay data. Historical class-mapping provenance is retained separately.
No class is inferred from a class short name. Unknown owned living classes must be rejected when extra Health might apply.
No static cap is supplied for groups with native Health improvements: leave their existing Health untouched.
LeafcutterSuperMajor has only a level-1 native row. Missing levels are deliberately unsupported.
The original health bytes of wounded or dead units must never be increased. Only over-cap Health is clamped.
Scope is native owned colony creatures in supported story/formicarium saves, not arbitrary custom maps or other stat-changing mods.
Captured EAA_SlaverCopy_v1 snapshots are skipped and reported, never deleted, released, re-owned, or rewritten. The native game decides their post-uninstall behavior on reload.

missingForeignDefaultEvidence.schema: FCreatureSaveState.bForeignSubTennent absent serialized property resolves false via LoadGameCompressed on Steam build 26412732
missingForeignDefaultEvidence.scope: Current native reload of the same 370-record historical fixture; explicit true remains unsupported

runtimeValidation.levels: All table-supported levels 1..3 for each covered class; LeafcutterSuperMajor only 1
runtimeValidation.arithmeticComparison: Exact IEEE754 binary32 bit equality, 0 mismatches
runtimeValidation.remainingClassEvidence: Native CDO or previous real actor class/name mapping, exact native table rows, and the same reviewed native stat functions; not claimed as runtime oracle coverage

historicalValidation.scope: Historical provenance only; native addresses are not asserted for current build.

currentTableValidation.scope: Every existing healthByLevel row matches both current native tables; class mappings retain historical asset/runtime provenance.
